title: For a revert check where the base file does not build against the new tests, give a ready overlay that reverts both the Go file and its test file

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-131403-3844, project ork, item S621:

For a revert check where the base file does not build against the new tests, give a ready overlay that reverts both the Go file and its test file

Evidence: Base overlays said internal/cli/wait.go does not build (unknown field slotWait at wait_test.go:694), so the revert was confirmed only by trace
